title: iHeartCountry Album Release Party with Riley Green on September 23 in Celebration of His New Album "That’s Just Me"
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*The event will be broadcast on iHeartCountry stations and stream live on iHeartCountry’s YouTube channel at 7 p.m. PT*


**WHAT:** The iHeartCountry Album Release Party with Riley Green will take place at the iHeartRadio Los Angeles Theater, be broadcast on iHeartCountry stations and will stream live on iHeartCountry’s YouTube channel on September 23 at 7 p.m. PT.


**WHO:** In celebration of Riley Green’s new album *That’s Just Me* , released on September 18, the event will feature a special interview with Riley Green hosted by iHeartCountry personality Anne Hudson and a special performance by Riley Green.


**WHEN:** Wednesday, September 23 at 7 p.m. PT


**WHERE:** The event will broadcast on iHeartCountry stations nationwide,[iHeartCountry](https://www.iheart.com/live/iheartcountry-4418) digital station and will stream live on iHeartCountry’s YouTube channel. Additionally, the event will be broadcast on select iHeartCountry Canada, iHeartCountry Australia and iHeartCountry New Zealand stations.


**MORE:** Fans can tune-in to iHeartRadio Los Angeles stations 104.3 MYFM, KOST 103.5, KFI AM640, and KLAC AM 570 for a chance to attend the show.


Support for the iHeartCountry Album Release Party with Riley Green furnished by Nashville Harbor Records & Entertainment.
